detail_en: Saudization bands for private firms; a Saudi earning 3,000 SAR or more counts as one worker
Residential 4,001-6,000 kWh tier raised from 12 to 20 halalas; upper tiers unified at 30 halalas
Residential tiers narrowed to 15 m3 steps; sewage charged at half the water rate
Residential tiers collapsed to 18 halalas up to 6,000 kWh and 30 above
Applied to electricity bills and most goods and services
1,000 SAR/month for civil and military employees, 500 SAR for retirees and social-security beneficiaries; about 50 bn SAR a year
About 660,497 Saudi workers expected to benefit (GOSI)
500 SAR/month for state employees, retirees and social-security families; Nitaqat threshold to 5,000 then 6,000 SAR
Residential 21/33 halalas plus a fixed charge of 70-100 SAR by breaker size
Residential tiers 1/2/4/6 SAR per m3 plus sewage and fixed fees by meter size
Six months after the measures start; start date not officially specified
